A NOTE FROM THE CREATOR

Made with mischief.

✿

Hi, I’m K. I make characters with dramatic backstories, collect stories like a tiny book dragon, and make little games while I learn to code. Sometimes a button works on the first try. I find that deeply suspicious.

Pick a fate, adopt something tiny, catch goblin coins, or just poke around. There’s probably a side quest hiding where I forgot to put one.

✦ Totally not made at 2 a.m. The tiny dragon will corroborate this.

✎ Kat’s margin note: The shelves and buttons got their own cute illustrations today. I’m trying very hard to be normal about the tiny pink monster. The draft still has side quests, and there are probably 249 tabs open. ♡ </end note>

Gerald Note: I filed the new pictures under “very cute and absolutely necessary.” The tiny monster has been promoted to unofficial quality inspector.

⚔ Dad’s guild notice: The lanterns are lit, the maps are unrolled, and the forest path is open. Come in from your quest; there’s a place by the fire.Notice: Dad’s arms are always open.

☾ Memaw’s purple haven: Pull up a soft chair, tuck a blanket around your shoulders, and stay as long as you like. There’s always room for one more story here. 💜

✿ Ma’s sunroom note: Your boots can go by the door, the kettle is ready, and there’s a basket for all the little things you brought home. A pretty place works best when you can really live in it.

🤖 Gerald’s little status report: Pink lights on. Tiny glasses polished. Bow tie straightened. The arcade’s cozy cyber systems are operational. Beep boop. ♡

✧ Derek’s cottage note: A fairy and a honey badger have borrowed the spellbook. The sunset looks like it’s trapped inside a bubble. There are choux pastries and shrimp chips on the table. Mind the doorway—you might stub your toe twice.

THE EXTREMELY IMPORTANT COUNTERIt counts. That is all.
